details: This package is a security-research / test artifact that fires a host-metadata beacon at install time. Its package.json declares a preinstall hook ("node preinstall.js"); that script collects os.hostname(), os.userInfo().username, a timestamp and the npm lifecycle event name, and POSTs them as a JSON message to a Discord webhook at hxxps://canary[.]discord[.]com/api/webhooks/1566232728179843243/[secret-redacted], then writes a.preinstall-marker.json file into the package directory. It declares itself a test ("security-research", "lifecycle-hooks", "test", "do-not-use" keywords; "local test marker" in its own output) and the payload stops at host metadata: it reads no credentials, tokens, environment values, wallet data or files, spawns no processes, and downloads no further code.
